notes.title: Dissonance Patch #2
notes.notes:
- Improved performance of the snowfield level.
- Improved stability of the magnet mechanic and consistency of pushing force.
- All enemy characters now turn more smoothly.
- Fixed a bug where the short invincibility after getting hit doesn't apply.
- Improved stability of checkpoint function.
- Improved visibility for some environmental interactables.

Have fun!
